scenario: When a Zendesk ticket is tagged 'bug_escalation', create a matching Jira issue with the ticket's product area, reproduction steps and customer tier, then write the Jira key back into the ticket's custom field.

When a linked Jira bug moves to 'Released', find every Zendesk ticket carrying that Jira key, set them to pending with the fix version in an internal note, and email each requester the release notice.
rule_hooks: Jira status to ticket status mapping

scenario: For Freshdesk tickets whose 'refund_status' field flips to Approved, create a refund receipt in QuickBooks against the customer's original invoice and record the QuickBooks transaction number on the ticket.

Read new rows in the warehouse's 'RMA Received' Google Sheet and update the matching Zendesk return tickets with received date, item condition and next step, closing tickets where condition is 'unopened'.
rule_hooks: item condition to return outcome table

scenario: Each week, pull CSAT survey responses from Zendesk and write the average score and latest comment onto the corresponding Salesforce account, flagging accounts with two consecutive scores under 3.
Find Zendesk tickets that breached first-response SLA yesterday and add or update a row per enterprise account in the Customer Success 'SLA Breaches' sheet, incrementing the monthly breach count.
rule_hooks: SLA policy targets by plan tier

scenario: When a HubSpot company's 'support_tier' property changes, update the organization in Zendesk to the new tier and re-prioritize its open tickets accordingly.
rule_hooks: support tier to default priority mapping

scenario: When an Intercom conversation is tagged 'needs_ticket', create a Freshdesk ticket with the transcript summary, customer email and plan, and post the Freshdesk ticket link back as a note in Intercom.
rule_hooks: conversation tag to ticket group routing

scenario: When a cancellation ticket in Help Scout is closed with a churn reason, update the Salesforce opportunity/account with churn reason, effective date and save-attempt outcome.

Sync Zendesk Guide articles last updated over 180 days ago into the 'KB Review' Notion database, creating a row per article with owner and section and updating rows whose article has since been revised.
Read the support team roster in Google Sheets and make sure each agent's Freshdesk group membership and availability match their assigned queue and shift in the sheet.
For new Gorgias or Zendesk tickets mentioning an order number, look up the order in Shopify and fill the ticket's order value, fulfillment status and ship date fields.
Read the account management team's VIP customer sheet and tag the matching Zendesk users and organizations 'vip', removing the tag from anyone no longer on the list.
rule_hooks: VIP list as source of truth

scenario: When a Stripe dispute is opened, create a high-priority Zendesk ticket for the billing team with charge amount, reason code and evidence deadline, linking any existing tickets from the same customer.
rule_hooks: dispute reason code to handling playbook

scenario: For tickets closed with a 'service_credit' resolution, create a credit note in Xero for the customer's contact with the credited amount and ticket reference, and log it in the 'Service Credits' sheet.

When a Statuspage incident is created, find Zendesk tickets opened since the incident start that mention the affected component and link them to a new problem ticket, copying the incident ID into each.
Weekly, collect Intercom conversations tagged 'feature_request' and add them as insights in Productboard against the matching feature, including the customer's ARR from HubSpot.
When a ticket is escalated to tier 3, create a row in the 'Escalations Log' Airtable base with ticket ID, account, owner and reason, and update the row's status when the ticket is solved.
When a customer's primary email changes in Salesforce, update the matching Zendesk user's primary identity and the Intercom contact, logging any conflicts where the new email already exists.
rule_hooks: CRM as master for contact data

scenario: For hardware support tickets with a serial number, look up the device in the 'Warranty Registry' sheet and set the ticket's warranty status and expiry fields, tagging out-of-warranty tickets for paid repair.

When a Freshservice/Freshdesk ticket gets a confirmed field-visit date, create a Google Calendar event for the assigned technician with the customer address and ticket link, and update the event if the date changes.
Monthly, count each account's open and reopened tickets in Zendesk and update HubSpot company properties 'support_tickets_30d' and 'support_health', setting health red above a threshold.

When a Help Scout conversation is marked as a confirmed bug, create a Linear issue with steps and affected customer count, or add the customer to the existing Linear issue if one matches the error code.

When a Chargebee subscription downgrades from Enterprise, update the customer's Zendesk organization plan field, remove them from the dedicated-agent group, and reassign open tickets to the general queue.
For approved return tickets in Gorgias, create a return shipment in ShipStation and write the tracking number and label URL back to the ticket, then email the customer the label.
rule_hooks: return eligibility window by product category

scenario: Every Monday, export last week's solved Zendesk tickets by contact-reason tag into the 'Support Weekly Metrics' Google Sheet, updating existing week rows rather than duplicating them.
When a ticket from a reseller-managed customer arrives, create a matching case in the partner's Salesforce Experience Cloud queue and mirror status updates back to the original Zendesk ticket.
When a DocuSign envelope for a support-plan amendment is completed, update the customer's SLA policy and entitled hours in Zendesk and in the 'Premium Support Contracts' sheet.
rule_hooks: contract plan to SLA policy mapping

scenario: Sum time-tracked minutes on each premium customer's solved Freshdesk tickets and update their remaining support-hours balance in HubSpot, notifying the account owner when under 10%.
After a Zoom screen-share support session ends, attach the meeting duration and recording link to the related Zendesk ticket (matched via the meeting topic's ticket number) and log the time spent.
rule_hooks: ticket ID parsing from meeting topic

scenario: When two HubSpot contacts are merged, merge the corresponding Intercom contacts and reassign the losing Zendesk user's tickets to the surviving user.
When a Zendesk macro referencing a KB article is edited, update the 'Macro-Article Map' sheet row with the new text and last-edited date, and flag rows where the linked article has been archived.

Tickets tagged 'formal_complaint' are copied into the regulatory complaints register in Smartsheet with received date, category and 8-week resolution deadline, and the register row is updated when the ticket closes.

When a data subject access or deletion request ticket is created, add a row to the Privacy Requests Airtable with request type and 30-day due date, and create a corresponding Asana task for the data team.
For billing tickets disputing a specific invoice, mark the invoice as 'in dispute' in QuickBooks via a memo and custom field, and record the ticket number so collections pauses dunning.

When a customer's onboarding project in Asana is marked complete, create the Zendesk organization with plan, CSM and go-live date from the project fields, and add the onboarding contacts as Zendesk users.
rule_hooks: onboarding field to org field mapping

scenario: For tickets resolved with 'send replacement', create a zero-value replacement sales order in NetSuite with the original SKU and shipping address, and write the order number back to the ticket.

Zendesk tickets in languages the team doesn't cover are added to the vendor translation tracker in Google Sheets, and returned translations in the sheet are posted back as internal notes on the tickets.
When a card in the 'Known Issues' Trello board moves to 'Published', create or update the matching Freshdesk solution article with the workaround text and affected versions from the card.
rule_hooks: board list to article status mapping

scenario: When the CSM owner on a Salesforce account changes, update the Zendesk organization's CSM field and add the new CSM as a CC on that organization's open escalated tickets.
rule_hooks: CSM CC policy for escalated tickets

scenario: When QA reviewers finish the weekly ticket-review sheet, copy each agent's scores into the team's coaching tracker in Asana. Agents below the target get a coaching task linked to the reviewed Zendesk ticket IDs.
rule_hooks: QA score threshold, rubric category weights

scenario: Each NPS response of 0-6 from the Delighted export creates a Freshdesk callback ticket for the account's support pod. The ticket carries the score and verbatim comment, and the survey row is updated with the ticket number.

Read agents' out-of-office events in Google Calendar and set them unavailable for round-robin in Zendesk for those dates. Post a Slack alert to the team lead if any queue drops below its minimum coverage.
rule_hooks: minimum agents per queue per shift

scenario: When HR publishes next year's regional holiday sheet, add the holidays to the matching Zendesk business-hours schedules. SLA clocks for the EMEA, APAC and Americas queues then pause correctly.

For tickets tagged refund_pending, look up the Stripe refund and write its status (succeeded, failed or pending) into the ticket field. Failed refunds are reopened with the failure reason as an internal note.

When agents grant goodwill account credits on Intercom-escalated B2B tickets, log each credit (account, amount, reason, agent) in finance's credit ledger Google Sheet. Credits above the agent's limit are flagged for manager approval.

Match each completed or missed Aircall call to the caller's open Zendesk ticket by phone number and add the call summary and recording link. If no ticket is open, create one and assign it to the phone line's group.

Turn negative brand mentions logged in the social-listening Google Sheet into Freshdesk tickets with the handle, post URL and sentiment. Write the ticket ID back to the sheet so the social team does not double-handle.

For new 1-2 star App Store and Google Play reviews collected in a sheet, create a mobile-queue helpdesk ticket with the app version and review text. When the agent marks the ticket solved, mark the review row as responded.
rule_hooks: star rating cutoff, app version to known-issue list

scenario: Weekly, add customers whose solved tickets got a 'great' CSAT rating to the Trustpilot review-invitation sheet. Skip anyone invited in the last 90 days or with another open ticket.
When a technician closes a work order in the field-service app, copy the work notes, parts used and completion time into the linked Zendesk ticket. Set the ticket to pending customer confirmation.
rule_hooks: work order status to ticket status mapping

scenario: When an agent ships a loaner unit, record the serial, customer and due date in the loaner tracker sheet and mirror the due date into a ticket field. Overdue loaners trigger a reminder on the ticket.
When the inventory sheet shows a revised restock ETA for a backordered SKU, update the ETA field on every open 'where is my order' ticket for that SKU. Send each affected customer a templated update.
rule_hooks: SKU match, ETA slip threshold for proactive notice

scenario: Turn ShipStation shipments with carrier exceptions (lost, returned to sender, address issue) into Gorgias tickets linked to the Shopify order. Tag each ticket with the exception type.

When quality publishes a product recall serial range, find matching customers in Salesforce assets and flag their accounts. Open a proactive helpdesk ticket for each affected customer, with the recall macro applied.
rule_hooks: affected serial ranges, region-specific recall notice

scenario: Help Center articles that pass a downvote ratio in the last 30 days get a card on the Notion content backlog. The card carries the voter comments and is assigned to the article's section owner.
rule_hooks: downvote ratio and minimum vote count

scenario: When customers opt into the beta via the Typeform, set the beta flag on their HubSpot company and tag their Zendesk organization. Their tickets then route to the beta support queue.
rule_hooks: plan eligibility for beta, enrollment cap

scenario: Sync each customer's authorized-support-contacts sheet into the matching Freshdesk company. Add new contacts, and downgrade removed contacts to view-only so they cannot open priority tickets.
rule_hooks: contact seat limit per support plan

scenario: When a ticket's 'callback requested' date and time field is filled in, create a Google Calendar event for the assignee in the customer's timezone with the ticket link. Move the event if the field changes.
When a trial user opens a support ticket, log the ticket as an activity on their open HubSpot deal and notify the deal owner. Trial-blocking issues get the deal's 'trial blocker' property set.
When a customer submits a tax-exemption certificate on a ticket, mark the QuickBooks customer as tax-exempt with the certificate number and expiry. Note the exemption on the ticket.
When a customer emails support a new purchase order for renewal, add the PO number and amount to their open Xero invoice reference. Update the PO field on their Salesforce account.
rule_hooks: PO amount vs invoice amount tolerance

scenario: For each Chargebee subscription that enters dunning after a failed card payment, open or update a billing-queue ticket with the failure reason and retry date. Flag the HubSpot contact as payment-at-risk.
When a cancellation-request ticket is confirmed by the agent, schedule the cancellation in Chargebee at term end. Write the effective date back to the ticket.
rule_hooks: contract notice period, annual vs monthly terms

scenario: Copy each Salesforce account's region and preferred language onto the matching Zendesk users and organization fields. Tickets then route to the right language and regional group.
Every Monday morning, write each helpdesk queue's open, pending and on-hold counts, plus the oldest ticket age, into the support-ops backlog Google Sheet. Post the queues over target to Slack.

Daily, read Salesforce support contracts that passed their end date without renewal. Set the matching Zendesk organizations to 'unentitled' so new tickets route to the renewals queue instead of technical support.

When agents tag tickets as a defect in a third-party component, add a row per ticket to the supplier-escalation tracker sheet with serial and failure mode. Email the supplier's quality contact a weekly batch.
Log damaged-in-transit tickets with photos into the carrier claims tracker with tracking number, declared value and filing deadline. Write the claim status back to the ticket.
rule_hooks: carrier claim windows, minimum claim value

scenario: When an agent completes a product certification course in the LMS, add the matching skill to their helpdesk profile. They then receive skills-based routed tickets for that product.
When BambooHR marks a support agent as terminated, reassign their open tickets in Freshdesk to their team lead and deactivate the agent. Post the reassigned list to the team's Slack channel.
rule_hooks: reassignment by group, escalated ticket handling

scenario: For each warranty-claim ticket, copy the customer's photo and receipt attachments into a Google Drive folder named by claim number. Put the folder link in a ticket field for the claims reviewer.
rule_hooks: claim numbering convention, required document list

scenario: Mirror HubSpot contacts marked do-not-contact or unsubscribed into a helpdesk user tag. These customers are then excluded from CSAT surveys and proactive outreach macros.
During the post-acquisition transition, mirror escalated tickets from the acquired brand's Freshdesk into the main Zendesk with linked IDs. Keep status and assignee consistent in both.
At month end, compute the service credits owed under each customer's contract for tickets that breached response SLA. Apply them as credit notes in Chargebee and note them on the account.
rule_hooks: contractual credit percentage table, credit cap

scenario: For each Jira bug linked from helpdesk tickets, sum the ARR of the affected Salesforce accounts and write it to the bug's 'customer impact ARR' field. Include the count of affected accounts.
rule_hooks: ARR source field, dedupe by account

scenario: When new products are added to the Shopify catalog, add them as options in the helpdesk's 'product' ticket dropdown. Discontinued SKUs are retired from the dropdown.
When an agent approves an apology discount on a ticket, create a single-use Shopify discount code for the customer. Post the code to the ticket and log it in the coupon-spend sheet.
rule_hooks: coupon value by issue category and order value

scenario: For out-of-warranty repair tickets, create a QuickBooks estimate from the diagnosed parts and labor hours, and email it to the customer. When the estimate is accepted, move the ticket to 'repair approved'.
rule_hooks: parts price list, labor rate by product

scenario: When a customer asks support to correct a shipping address, update the Shopify order and the ShipStation shipment if the order has not been fulfilled. Otherwise tag the ticket for carrier intercept.
